title: HELIX Section Agent Trajectory
description: A complete record of one attempt by the CodexSectionAgent to draft a section. Authored as a design artifact to specify what bounded-path behavior looks like; feeds back into Phase 1 CodexSectionAgent implementation. Not wired in CI until Phase 1 yields real trajectories.

trajectory_id.description: Unique identifier for this trajectory record.

attempt.description: Which attempt number this is within the run (ADR-0016 bounds this).

registered_tools.description: The tools the sandbox allowed for this run, as declared by the section package.

turns.description: The full conversation turns: alternating assistant (with optional tool calls) and tool-result turns.

terminal_output.description: The SectionDraftCandidate the agent produced, or null on a structured failure with no output.

registered_tools_used.description: The subset of registered_tools the agent actually called. A-2 asserts this equals registered_tools_used and nothing outside it.

unregistered_tool_attempts.description: Any tool calls the sandbox rejected as unregistered. A-2 asserts this is empty.

paths_accessed.description: Every file path the agent read during the attempt.

paths_outside_dependencies.description: Any path the agent attempted to read that falls outside the envelope's direct_dependencies. A-2 asserts this is empty.
